result.summary: Found 1 issue: low-contrast heart icons on dark food card backgrounds.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icons on the Tokumaru Ramen and pizza cards appear to be dark-colored icons placed on top of dark food image backgrounds, making them nearly invisible.
issues.suggestion: Use white or light-colored heart icons, or add a semi-transparent circular backdrop behind each icon to ensure visibility against any image background.
